name: media-analysis
title_zh: 本地 ffprobe 量出视频/音频的硬事实
tagline_zh: 装之前先问它：时长、分辨率、帧率、编码、声道、静音段、响度、完整性。
tagline_en: Before you decide, ask it: duration, resolution, fps, codecs, channels, silence, loudness, integrity, scene.
desc_en: Measure deterministic facts about a media file (container, streams, video/audio format, silence, loudness, integrity, scene cuts, timing) with local ffprobe/ffmpeg and return a structured Observation. Use when a task needs to *know* something about a video or audio file before deciding anything: duration, resolution, fps, CFR/VFR, codecs, channel layout, where the silence is, how loud it is (LUFS
why_zh: 它只输出可验证的确定性事实，不掺模型幻觉；用 ffprobe/ffmpeg 的底层解析。
why_en: It outputs only verifiable deterministic facts, no model hallucination; uses ffprobe/ffmpeg's low-level parsing, more reliable.
limit_zh: 只认本地已装的 ffprobe/ffmpeg，不处理在线文件；只测媒体物理属性，不分析内容语义（如人脸、字幕、情感）。
limit_en: Requires local ffprobe/ffmpeg; no online files. Measures physical media properties only, not semantics (faces, subtitles, emotion). Returns.
title_en: Measure video/audio hard facts locally with ffprobe
